description.value:
While many humans vary in shape and size, your human character will have these traits.

Ability Score Increase. One ability score of your choice increases by 2 and other ability scores increase by 1. Choosing different Human races replaces this ASI.

Age. Humans reach adulthood in their teens and live for around a century.

Alignment. There is no clear alignment that is consistent among all humans. Just about any alignment can be justified.

Size. Humans in the Jujutsu Kaisen world are typically 5-6 feet tall. Some can rest far outside this range, but your size will count as medium.

Speed. Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
